args.code:
p = session.Parts.Work
helix = [f for f in p.Features if str(f.FeatureType) == 'HELIX'][-1]
b = p.Features.CreateTubeBuilder(NXOpen.Features.Tube.Null)
try:
    b.Tolerance = 0.01
    rule = p.ScRuleFactory.CreateRuleCurveFeature([helix])
    b.PathSection.AddToSection([rule], helix.GetEntities()[0], NXOpen.NXObject.Null, NXOpen.NXObject.Null, NXOpen.Point3d(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), NXOpen.Section.Mode.Create, False)
    b.OuterDiameter.RightHandSide = '8'
    b.InnerDiameter.RightHandSide = '0'
    tube = b.CommitFeature()
finally:
    b.Destroy()
result = [len(list(body.GetFaces())) for body in tube.GetBodies()]
